name: biscuit gallery
about_text: biscuit gallery is a contemporary art gallery that opened in Shibuya, Tokyo in March 2021 before relocating to Shinjuku in June 2025. Alongside its Tokyo space it is preparing a second venue in Karuizawa, Nagano, due to open in summer 2026. The gallery represents a roster of emerging Japanese and Asian painters, photographers and mixed-media artists, and regularly presents them at international art fairs across Asia and Europe. Its program has included group and solo shows spanning painting, photography, sculpture and installation, often highlighting younger and Gen Z artists exploring identity, memory and material experimentation. Beyond its exhibition program, biscuit gallery runs an online shop, an art storage service, and 'grid next,' an open-call initiative supporting the discovery of new artists.

notes: The site also describes a 'grid next' open-call exhibition program for discovering young artists, an online shop, a newsletter/waiting list system for pre-sale price lists, and an art storage service; some fair pages describe artists as 'management' or 'associate' artists rather than strictly 'represented,' which may not perfectly align with the represented-artist roster list.

triage.site_notes: The site is a WordPress blog-style gallery site with a separate Shopify shop subdomain hosting the artist roster and product pages; exhibitions are split into current/upcoming/past category feeds rather than a static archive, and there is no dedicated 'about' or 'contact/hours' page in the crawl despite the gallery clearly having physical locations (Shibuya, Karuizawa).
